license_required.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless: (a) The person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the Nevada State Board of Optometry.

name.quote: "Board" means the Nevada State Board of Optometry.

type.quote: The Nevada State Board of Optometry, consisting of four members appointed by the Governor, is hereby created.

age_minimum.quote: Is at least 21 years of age;

degree_required.value: Doctor of Optometry from an accredited school of optometry
degree_required.quote: Has graduated from a school of optometry accredited or approved by the Board pursuant to NRS 636.135;

accrediting_body.value: Nevada State Board of Optometry (or nationally recognized accrediting organization approved by the Board)
accrediting_body.quote: The Board shall accredit schools, or approve the accreditation of schools by any nationally recognized accrediting organization or agency

exams.name: Comprehensive National Optometry Examination (National Board of Examiners in Optometry)
exams.quote: Has passed each part of the comprehensive national optometry examination administered by the National Board of Examiners in Optometry or its successor;

exams.name: Nevada State Board of Optometry examination
exams.notes: Each examination identified, administered or approved by the Board
exams.quote: Has passed each examination identified, administered or approved by the Nevada State Board of Optometry pursuant to NRS 636.150;

interval_years.quote: A license issued under this chapter or any former law must be renewed pursuant to the provisions of NRS 636.250 to 636.285, inclusive, before March 1 of each even-numbered year.

required.quote: The renewal fee must be accompanied by satisfactory evidence that the licensee has, within the immediately preceding 24-month period, completed the required number of hours in a course or courses of continuing education that have been approved by the Board.

hours_per_period.quote: The Board shall not require a licensee to complete more than 40 hours of continuing education during each period of renewal.

period_years.quote: within the immediately preceding 24-month period, completed the required number of hours in a course or courses of continuing education

value: At least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure

At least 2 hours of training relating specifically to persons with substance use and other addictive disorders and the prescribing of opioids (for optometrists certified to prescribe pharmaceutical agents and registered to dispense controlled substances)
topical_requirements.quote: The Board shall require each licensee to complete at least 2 hours of training in the screening, brief intervention and referral to treatment approach to substance use disorder within 2 years after initial licensure as part of the continuing education required by subsection 2.

available.quote: The Board may issue a license by endorsement to engage in the practice of optometry to an applicant who meets the requirements set forth in this section. An applicant may submit to the Board an application for such a license if the applicant holds a corresponding valid, active and unrestricted license to engage in the practice of optometry in the District of Columbia or any state or territory of the United States.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a valid, active, unrestricted license in another US jurisdiction; no adverse actions in past 5 years; continuously and actively practiced for past 5 years; not licensed in Nevada in the immediately preceding year; not disciplined or under investigation; not held civilly or criminally liable for malpractice. Military members/veterans/spouses may qualify under a separate expedited endorsement pathway.
requirements.quote: Has had no adverse actions reported to the National Practitioner Data Bank within the past 5 years; Has been continuously and actively engaged in the practice of optometry for the past 5 years; Has not held a license to practice optometry in this State in the immediately preceding year; Has not been disciplined and is not currently under investigation

regulatory_model.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless: (a) The person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

credential_type.quote: The Board may grant or refuse licenses after examination and discipline licensees for any of the causes specified in this chapter.

is_mandatory.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless: (a) The person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

title_protection.quote: Advertisement or representation as an optometrist.

scope_protection.quote: a person shall not engage in the practice of optometry in this State unless: (a) The person has obtained a license pursuant to the provisions of this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of a felony relating to optometry or a gross misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission by the licensee of a felony relating to the practice of optometry or a gross misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of fraud in obtaining a license or renewal, or in practicing optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of fraud by or on behalf of the licensee in obtaining a license or a renewal thereof, or in practicing optometry thereunder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Alcohol or other substance use disorder
disciplinary_grounds.quote: An alcohol or other substance use disorder.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross incompetency in the practice of optometry
Mental or physical disorder seriously impairing competency as an optometrist
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Affliction with any mental or physical disorder or disturbance seriously impairing his or her competency as an optometrist.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making false or misleading representations regarding optometric materials or services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making false or misleading representations, by or on behalf of the licensee, with respect to optometric materials or services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing or attempting to practice optometry while intoxicated
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practice by the licensee, or attempting or offering so to do, while in an intoxicated condition.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Perpetration of unethical or unprofessional conduct in the practice of optometry
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Perpetration of unethical or unprofessional conduct in the practice of optometry.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of the provisions of this chapter or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of the provisions of this chapter or any regulations adopted pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Operating a medical facility whose license is suspended or revoked, or during an act/omission resulting in suspension or revocation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Operation of a medical facility, as defined in NRS 449.0151, at any time during which: (a) The license of the facility is suspended or revoked; or (b) An act or omission occurs which results in the suspension or revocation of the license pursuant to NRS 449.160.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with specified pharmacy and controlled substance statutes and regulations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to comply with the provisions of NRS 453.163, 453.164, 453.226, 639.23507, 639.23535 and 639.2391 to 639.23916, inclusive, and any regulations adopted by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant thereto.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance in schedule III or IV
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraudulent, illegal, unauthorized or otherwise inappropriate prescribing, administering or dispensing of a controlled substance listed in schedule III or IV.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any violation of state or federal law or regulation relating to the practice of optometry, including organizational structure, medical records, improper disclosure, or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any violation of a state or federal law or regulation relating to or involving the practice of optometry, including, without limitation, a violation relating to: (a) The organizational structure or control of any optometric practice or entity; (b) The maintenance, availability or distribution of any medical record of a patient; (c) The improper disclosure of any protected information of a patient; and (d) Fraud.

definition_quote.value: The acts set forth in this section, or any of them, whether done severally, collectively or in combination with other acts that are not set forth in this section constitute practice in optometry within the purview of this chapter
definition_quote.quote: The acts set forth in this section, or any of them, whether done severally, collectively or in combination with other acts that are not set forth in this section constitute practice in optometry within the purview of this chapter

value: Advertisement or representation as an optometrist
Adapting, prescribing or dispensing ophthalmic lenses, frames or mountings
Examination, evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its appendages
Measurement of the powers or range of human vision
Prescribing, directing the use of or using optical devices for ocular exercises, orthoptics, vision rehabilitation, vision therapy or visual training
Prescribing of contact lenses
Measurement, initial fitting or adaptation of contact lenses
Topical use of pharmaceutical agents for diagnosis
Prescribing, directing the use of or using a pharmaceutical agent or device to treat an abnormality of the eye or its appendages
Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye
Removing eyelashes with forceps
Closing the lacrimal punctum of the eye
Ordering or performing laboratory tests or imaging to assist in diagnosis
methods_authorized.quote: The examination, evaluation, diagnosis and treatment of the human eye and its appendages, the measurement of the powers or range of human vision by any means

drug_authority.value: Licensed optometrists may administer topical diagnostic ophthalmic agents; optometrists certified pursuant to NRS 636.288 may administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents (topical or oral drugs for examination, management or treatment of eye conditions), including analgesics subject to schedule III, IV, or V, but excluding schedule I and II drugs.
drug_authority.quote: "Pharmaceutical agent" means any topical or oral drug used or prescribed by a licensee for the examination, management or treatment of an abnormality, disease or condition of the eye or its appendages, including, without limitation, any analgesic drug subject to the requirements of NRS 636.2882 or added to schedule III, schedule IV or schedule V by the State Board of Pharmacy by regulation pursuant to NRS 453.146. The term does not include any drug or other substance added to schedule I or schedule II by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to that section.

surgery_prohibited.quote: The provisions of this section do not authorize an optometrist to engage in any practice which includes: (a) Any procedure using a laser, scalpel, needle or other instrument in which any human tissue is cut, burned or vaporized by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, radiation or other means; or (b) Any procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp or similar device.

surgery_definition.value: Any procedure using a laser, scalpel, needle or other instrument in which any human tissue is cut, burned or vaporized by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, radiation or other means; or any procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp or similar device.
surgery_definition.quote: Any procedure using a laser, scalpel, needle or other instrument in which any human tissue is cut, burned or vaporized by incision, injection, ultrasound, laser, infusion, cryotherapy, radiation or other means; or (b) Any procedure using an instrument which requires the closure of human tissue by suture, clamp or similar device.

foreign_body_removal_authorized.quote: Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye.

value: Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye

minor_surgical_procedures_authorized.quote: Removing a foreign object from the surface or epithelium of the eye. (j) Removing eyelashes with forceps. (k) Closing the lacrimal punctum of the eye.

glaucoma_treatment_authorized.quote: An optometrist shall not treat a person diagnosed with glaucoma unless the optometrist has been issued a certificate by the Board pursuant to NRS 636.2895 or certification by endorsement pursuant to NRS 636.2897.

vision_therapy_authorized.quote: Prescribing, directing the use of or using any optical device in connection with ocular exercises, orthoptics, vision rehabilitation, vision therapy or visual training.

value: Schedule I drugs are excluded from pharmaceutical agent authority
Schedule II drugs are excluded from pharmaceutical agent authority
Schedule III and IV controlled substances may be prescribed only by certified optometrists, subject to conditions and limitations
controlled_substance_schedule_restrictio.quote: The term does not include any drug or other substance added to schedule I or schedule II by the State Board of Pharmacy pursuant to that section.

opioid_prescription_day_limit.quote: Prescribes the controlled substance in an amount that does not exceed 90 morphine milligram equivalents per day and will not last more than 72 hours;

oral_pharmaceutical_authority.quote: "Pharmaceutical agent" means any topical or oral drug used or prescribed by a licensee for the examination, management or treatment of an abnormality, disease or condition of the eye or its appendages

pharmaceutical_certification_required.quote: An optometrist shall not administer or prescribe a pharmaceutical agent other than a diagnostic pharmaceutical agent unless the optometrist has obtained a certificate pursuant to NRS 636.288.

dea_registration_required.quote: each optometrist who is certified to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents pursuant to NRS 636.288 and who is registered to dispense controlled substances pursuant to NRS 453.231

value: Certificate to administer and prescribe pharmaceutical agents (NRS 636.288)
Certificate to treat persons diagnosed with glaucoma (NRS 636.2895)
Certificate by endorsement to treat persons diagnosed with glaucoma (NRS 636.2897)
Certificate to own or operate a mobile optometry clinic (NRS 636.2899)
specialty_certification_types.quote: An optometrist shall not administer or prescribe a pharmaceutical agent other than a diagnostic pharmaceutical agent unless the optometrist has obtained a certificate pursuant to NRS 636.288.

pharmacology_training_hours_required.quote: The successful completion of not fewer than 40 hours of clinical training in administering and prescribing pharmaceutical agents in a training program which is conducted by an ophthalmologist and approved by the Board.

supervised_clinical_internship_required.quote: The successful completion of not fewer than 40 hours of clinical training in administering and prescribing pharmaceutical agents in a training program which is conducted by an ophthalmologist and approved by the Board.

referral_to_physician_required.quote: An optometrist, regardless of whether he or she has been issued a certificate to treat persons diagnosed with glaucoma pursuant to NRS 636.2895 or certification by endorsement pursuant to NRS 636.2897, shall refer a patient diagnosed with glaucoma to an ophthalmologist for treatment if any one of the following is applicable

comanagement_with_ophthalmologist_requir.quote: Proof that each optometrist who applies for a certificate has treated at least 15 persons who were: (a) Diagnosed with glaucoma by an ophthalmologist licensed in this State; and (b) Treated by the optometrist, in consultation with that ophthalmologist, for at least 12 consecutive months

delegation_to_unlicensed_assistants_auth.quote: an assistant may fit ophthalmic lenses or spectacle lenses if the assistant acts under the direct supervision of a licensed optometrist.

telemedicine_authorized.quote: a person shall not engage in optometric telemedicine to provide health care services to a patient located at an originating site in this State unless the person is licensed to practice optometry pursuant to this chapter.

mobile_office_authorized.quote: a licensee, nonprofit or charitable organization, governmental agency or school in this State who obtains a certificate pursuant to this section may own or operate a mobile optometry clinic pursuant to this section.

jurisprudence_exam_required.quote: Statutes and regulations governing the practice of optometry.
